definitions.gloss: to reread; to read over again
definitions.explanation: To read something again, often to check for mistakes, refresh one's memory, or understand it better. Compound of {読|よ}む (to read) + {直|なお}す (to redo).

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{直|なお}した。
⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わからず、⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧{読|よ}み{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I didn't understand the meaning, so I read it over again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{読|よ}み{直|なお}して{誤|ご}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}した→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: Before submitting it, I reread the report from the beginning and fixed the errors.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) + {直|なお}す (to redo, to fix). The ～{直|なお}す suffix means to do an action over again, often to correct or improve on the first attempt.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the thing reread (⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{直|なお}す).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧{読|よ}み{直|なお}す: to read it once more
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{読|よ}み{直|なお}す: to reread from the start
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{読|よ}み{直|なお}す: to reread many times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}す→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧: to read back over — very close in meaning; often interchangeable
- ⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧: to look over again; to reassess — broader, not limited to reading text
